alice_appearance.scope: Alice hair, headband and open-eye irises; all existing selected expressions, including adult states

aquatic_basin_hat.scope: The aquatic Marisa hat: outside the land hat's cone tiers turned round under its own bent tip, band and bow; set down it is the worn hat flipped at the same size (round, 1.0x; user 2026-11-01), a lily pad on the water: a fixed presentation waterline 0.5 model units under the brim face, the brim level from the opening then falling to the water with its edge just under it (no raised rim), the base tier upright round a dry basin below the water, the lower tiers pressed into a keel. aquatic_basin_hat is the worn and item mesh (accessory_marisa frame), aquatic_basin_hat_turned the set-down hull (marisa_hat_turned frame, already pressed). hull_bounds holds the plain sizes the game places and draws by (waterline, mouth, floor, brim, keel, the captain's stern seat, the brim ring for a sitting child, the stores texture tiers). The stores texture reuses the existing 16x16 food_layer.png unchanged. Project design: tiers are total stored portions [from, to]; tier 0 draws nothing. For each other tier, f = radius_fractions[tier], R = basin floor radius: disc radius f*R, centre (x=0, z=-(1-f)*R), tangent to the bow-side wall (-Z), before the captain. Fixed hull-space UVs (+X right, +Z down), repeating at 16 pixels per block; smaller discs crop the same texture without stretching. Project design; visual review remains pending.

aquatic_tools.scope: Braid cradle, mouth bite (two hard yanks per loop), capsize, self-rescue and hull-life clips (project original / ecology design D 3.4). The game draws the real vanilla stick the braid holds; the withdrawn `paddle_stick` and `marisa_hat_wetline` props stay out of the export.

body_core_cavity.geometry: body/BodyCavity shares the actual opening with injury hit checks; client clips skin and face layers, skins the authored dough lip and filling walls toward one central core; CoreTaken remains keep an empty cavity

body_marks.geometry: client/WoundRenderer uses body/BodySigns for stable mould sites, continuous sole projection and actual deep wounds; surface materials shared with body_wounds.surface_materials

braid_water_rescue.scope: v4 mouth-bite rescue geometry (project original, not canon): standard-adult mouth_root and mouth_reach for the rim bite, no whole-body tilt (root rotation 0), phase ticks offer/bite/push/slide/settle/release. In these rescue clips the two natural Marisa braid segments only hold the stick or lightly touch the rim; lifting a young, hooking a brim and pushing a hat over are the separate aquatic_tools clips (braid_cradle_lift, water_hat_climb, water_hat_right).

care_props.scope: 2026-10-17 unified restyle of care props: shared four-step palette, 1/16-grid low-poly meshes, no black outlines; shop goods are cream ceramic, mint plastic, strawberry fabric and kraft paper, wild items are leaves, twigs, straw, cardboard and soil. User-confirmed leaf bed, twig barrier and house eggs are untouched.

vanilla_texture_references.note: Parts of these meshes name vanilla textures instead of carrying pixels; they resolve to the player's Minecraft resources at runtime and are not stored in the repository.

forest_burrow/personal_leaf_nest/bedding: block/oak_leaves, birch_leaves, spruce_leaves (tinted), short_grass, moss_block, podzol_top, coarse_dirt, oak_log, spruce_log, hay_block_top, item/wheat
predator_nest: block/oak_log, spruce_log, hay_block_side, moss_block, podzol_top, coarse_dirt, oak_leaves, birch_leaves, dead_bush, item/feather

care_props.material_tiles: kit.py material tiles: palette colours drawn as 16x16 texel tiles with sparse one-step pixel noise, world-aligned at 1 texel per unit (vanilla density), for the low-poly care props; the placed pet goods are placed_goods; wild self-built nests are wild.py

placed_goods.author: standards/yukkuri-library/drafts/care-props/placed.py
placed_goods.style: rounded low-poly solids (revolved circles / rounded rectangles, no staircase cells) with hand-painted regions at about one texel per unit; several dye-selected colour / pattern styles per item on the same geometry; fills are heap-only meshes drawn inside any bowl style; footprints are unchanged except the pet cushion nest (26.6 across, a 23 square level pad so a full-term 1.2x adult lies in it); the two pet nests collide along their visible top surface
placed_goods.styles_table: life/CareStyles.java (dye -> style) mirrors placed.STYLES; non-default styles ship as runtime-peripheral attachments named <block id>_<style>
placed_goods.runtime_hook: client/CareRenderer draws <model>[_<style>] from CareBlockEntity Pattern, then the fill mesh for bowls, and toilet_waste (half scale, on the floor at y 1 / 1.5) once per stored dropping in ceramic_toilet and covered_toilet

carry_hold.scope: Reimu's mouth_release (markers open/release/closed: a young emerges from her mouth before it is let go); the generic held item: Marisa's braid (the braid_item_hold overlay ashore and boat_paddle's loop start aboard, braid_item_pick contact, braid_item_place release; props.item uses the paddle's grip and twig frame on hand_right_tip, contacts.braid_grip) and the mouth for the others (mouth_item_pick bite, mouth_item_place release; drawn at the mouth anchor); boat_puff, the seated captain's puff with the braid at its boat rest; the aquatic self hat clips (hat_off_self_aq, hat_on_self_aq: hat.stick) keep the held stick in the tuft, laid along the brim it hooks, handed over from and back to the hold with the braid (user 2026-11-05 feedback 2). Project design (user 2026-11-04 feedback 1, 2 and 6). Chen's two-tail carry reuses the client CarryTailCurl seats unchanged.

core_filling.origin: project original; no external reference image

den_barrier.scope: Den-mouth screen block (settlement/DenBarrierBlock, collision 14x16x14, no facing): native cuboid block model of twigs wedged into the soil, leaned along each side or tipped inward against the opposite side, a few fallen at 45 degrees, two forked shoots, a crossed loose wad of leaf litter in the middle, leaves pushed into gaps and scattered at the foot; nothing tied, knotted or woven; uneven tops and visible gaps. Hand-painted 64x64 texture from the wild_kit ramps. Project design (user request); no user visual acceptance yet.

hair_wounds.scope: Redrawn pixel-authored eight mechanical styles with grade-specific outlines, separate skin/hair clipping, shared indentation, shared skin/hair core-channel clipping, low-poly vertical cavity walls and flat bottoms, species filling palettes for red bean, custard, chocolate, white chocolate and meat bun with a generic fallback, plus sole/whole-body heat and character expression atlases. Runtime reprojects the source parameters at each authoritative wound anchor and retains bone weights, real hair loss, treatment scars and corpse state. House forms select only grade-three thermal art.

hat_care_contact.scope: Fitted Marisa and congenital variants; same-tread crawl, supported tuck, precise held mouth anchors and finite complete-mesh contact checks. Carry braid fold uses the same existing hand bones and weighted source vertices in animation and geometry.

hat_interactions.head: Per variant `head`: the bare head's flat top (hat off) as [x0, z0, x1, z1, top] support cells in the hat_follow frame within HEAD_BAND (0.5 model units) of the hair peak, margin and obstacles in the ring schema (project design, user 2026-11-04).

hat_vessel.cabin_revision: Aquatic hat 1.4x the land hat (project design: 1.5 filled the opening with an adult captain and 1.4 was chosen from the preview). Afloat the crown is pressed to 0.55 and the front tread is 0.6 deep so the young read from the bank. Three crown tiers hollowed with a wall-connected front tread 2.01 hat units deep; four shared cavity sections. Offline preview only, awaiting game verification.
hat_vessel.scope: Marisa's own worn hat copied box for box, opened into a well and turned upside down with its crown pressed flat (user 2026-10-15: just turn the hat over and squash its bottom): on land, where her braid presses it down to catch young, and afloat (the aquatic hat boat, larger, and the hat floated at a bank to catch); braid placements read by the lore hat clips and the game

house_ecology.note: 2026-10-18: nest_lint and food_scrap are no longer player items; they remain registered only as internal carriers for ground debris, mouth and nest display. Models and textures are unchanged; no new art was added by the house ecology rework.
house_ecology.scope: Cotton lint and dust for nest building; empty lower eggshell derived from approved intact egg. Approved egg meshes remain unchanged; the shared 2.4 world scale and four spaced slots fit the unchanged 0.32 newborn. Hatching choreography is original adaptation.

house_ecology_presentation.scope: Original peek, tend, listen, startled and lost-home motion adaptation; not a frame-by-frame reconstruction of published artwork.

house_repellent.scope: Original handheld spray bottle, nozzle, trigger and barred-yukkuri face label. Native item geometry uses vanilla block surface textures; no item icon is reused, no block is placed. Existing item ID is retained for save compatibility.

large_wild_nest.role: wild family bedding (wild_kit atlas): leaf-litter pad at the collision floor 0.5 with lining leaves, moss and hay, no marked places; rim of loose dry grass pressed down in layers, up to 3 high, following the collision rim and front shoulders, twigs worked in, open front

large_nests.geometry: 2x2 block footprint (32 x 32 units) centred on the origin = shared corner of the four blocks; entrance +z; 31-cell rounded (squircle n=4) outline at half-extent 15.5, one-cell rim leaving a 29-unit interior (collision interior 28.5), rim at most 3 high, down to the floor across 14 units of the south side and 2 high to |x| 11; family members settle anywhere
